rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the tank's current energy must be strictly greater than the shot's power; if it does not fire, this says nothing.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward it must have at least 80 pixels of free space ahead, and whenever it drives backward it must have at least 80 pixels of free space behind; if it does not drive, nothing is required.

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules hold, but the battles logged an S2 violation
explanation.summary: Verus proved S1 (never fire a shot you can't afford) and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px); no rule was rejected. The battles did log an S2 violation, on turn 0 in the open arena (1 turn) and from turn 0 in the city map (33 turns), but S2 is not among the rules given for this check, so I can't say what it covers.
